0.long_answer: Research into Absent tibia‐polydactyly‐arachnoid cyst syndrome evaluated whether mutations in a gene located on chromosome 2 might be responsible for the condition. The gene studied was the Indian hedgehog (IHH) gene, which is known to be important in skeletal development. Analysis of patients with the syndrome revealed that no abnormalities were present in the IHH gene, thus excluding it as the cause of the syndrome.
